title: menuSelect Widget: hide when only one option (other than seeAllOption)
body: **Describe the bug 🐛** When using a `menuSelect` widget, if there is only one option (other than the `seeAllOption`), this widget should be hidden since selecting that single option is the same as selecting the `seeAllOption` **To Reproduce 🔍** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Add a `menuSelect` widget that will only have one option 2. See that selecting that option is the same as the `seeAllOption` **Expected behavior 💭** If there is only one option other than the `seeAllOption` this widget should be hidden. **Screenshots 🖥**
